reason: Mechanically the kernel could be coded, dummy-run and scored well before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC, because the division pass costs almost nothing at runtime against the 12 h limit. The problem is the honest validation step the idea requires. The only valid bed for an in-relink flow pass is the H3 'x138-tail lab', and it does not exist. It is a separate proposed enabler (h_linking-on-x138.json, idea x138-tail-lab-headcoords, 58 h to its own probe). It needs friend A to upload the capture npz files and raw graphs, plus about 6 h of agent work, and it still lacks the gap-fill pool. The named fallback does not test this idea. replay.py (experiments/l2_daughternet/replay/replay.py L1-13) starts from the exp39 POST-GAP ckpt, and the exp39 notebook has 0 MOTION_RELINK_FLOW knobs. So the fallback can only test a post-tail geometric insertion on a different base. That insertion is essentially div_insert with a geometric score, which is not the 'inside the assignment' mechanism the idea claims as new. The lab caches live only on friend A's PC and friend C's Mac. The Kaggle CPU lab port (tools/kaggle_lab.py) is paused and unfinished (CONTEXT.md L1545). Friend A has made no commits since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK and is queued to build an x138 cache for the #35 insertion retune (CONTEXT.md L1543-1544). The chance that a scored probe passes the pre-registered gate, all guesses: base confirmed by #34 0.85 x code and tests by Sat 26 noon 0.9 x an honest lab result by Mon 28 20:00 UTC 0.55 x gate pass 0.33 x slot and user OK 0.9 x clean run 0.95 = about 0.12. Submitting without the gate gives about 0.36. Skipping the lab entirely gives about 0.65, and that is not an honest probe. All three are below 0.70. Numbers checked: caps 0.0076/0.00375 and DeepCenter safe-div 0.25 in x138 cell 0; B32 58/97/121 of 151 (RESULTS.md L121); J_pub 0.36, break-even 0.265, floor 0.31 (CONTEXT L1319-1320); forum 8.85/4.57 um (browser_research L94). Two claims are inaccurate. First, OUTPUT_DIVISION_GEOMETRY_FILTER is OFF on x138 (default '0', not set in cell 0), so 'mark division=1 so the geometry filter keeps them' is moot. Second, the 'both steps 2-7 um' gate drops more than 25% of real daughter steps (GT division step p75 7.36, p90 9.07; CONTEXT L734), and a velocity-compensated midpoint was already WORSE than the plain midpoint in the v2 div_audit9 (wf_ideas_v2 r1 fork-midpoint notes L17). Implementation is heavier than 5 h. motion_relink_edges runs twice when readmit adds nodes (cell 5 L1942-1947). The DeepCenter veto needs deepcenter_bundle and the frame cache passed into a function whose signature has neither. The safe-div caps live downstream in add_safe_divisions_postlink, so relink forks need their own cap accounting. Steal-with-repair needs a re-solve per stolen neighbour. --base x138 allows only divinsert|leafprune, so this needs a new patch with anchors in compact JSON. Realistic effort is 7-9 agent hours.
fix_if_any: Replace the missing H3 bed with a cheaper lab that already has all its inputs: an 'x138-relink-only' replay on the exp39 RAW ILP graphs friend C already holds (raw/ + dc/, image-free, used in B31). Run x138 cell-5 motion_relink_edges (flow_mode seed, tight 5.5 / flow tight 7, bonus 1.0) through exec of the verbatim cell source, with readmit, gap-close, gap2 and gapfill OFF in BOTH arms. Then run the public safe-div port with DeepCenter from dc/ at raw nodes, the tail, and the official metric. Control = pass OFF, treatment = pass ON. The kernel function and the lab must be the same text, taken from tools/build_probe_kernel.py as for edgefilter and stitch. Use integer coordinates (no head) and say so. Limit steal-with-repair to 1 steal per parent and count relink forks against SAFE_DIV_GLOBAL/FRAME caps by pre-decrementing the budget passed into add_safe_divisions_postlink. Drop the 'both steps 2-7 um' gate: use 2-9 um, since the GT division-step p90 is 9.07. Pre-register a grid of at most 6 lambda/r_steal values on SELECTION, then run CONFIRMATION once. Schedule: agent writes the patch and tests Fri 25 12:00-20:00Z. Agent writes the lab builder Fri 25 20:00Z-Sat 26 02:00Z. Friend C runs the grid and confirmation Sat 26 08:00-18:00Z (about 4-6 CPU-h). Vitalii dummy-runs after the GPU reset, Sat 26 about 06:00-08:00Z (about 0.7 T4-h, same code; the knob set later changes only env values). Submit Sat 26 about 20:00Z, or Sun 27 by 12:00Z, and it is scored by Sun 27 22:00Z. That leaves more than 30 h of buffer. If #35 wins, apply the pass before divinsert and skip parents that already have a fork. With this repair the probability of a scored probe (gate included) is about 0.85 x 0.9 x 0.75 x 0.33 x 0.9 = 0.17. It stays gate-limited, not schedule-limited.
realistic_public_gain: +0.000 central (range -0.002..+0.002). The analogue (DaughterNet steal insertion) gave LB +0.001. The GT geometry gates as written cut reach. v2 found the velocity-compensated midpoint worse than the plain one. Overlap with the #35 insertion means that if #35 wins, the two gains do not add.
realistic_private_gain: +0.000 to +0.002 (guess). It uses no network, but fork precision is density-dependent, and on unseen embryos it may fall below the 0.265 break-even.
